target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Hays and Comal — vouchered in the Texas Hill Country grass flora; Travis — USDA/Rootfast county distribution layer records the species in Travis County.

morphology.look_here_first: Start with the whole plant architecture. Oldfield threeawn is an annual with wiry culms and a much more open, branched panicle than purple threeawn. Its three awns are extremely long and spreading, often 3–7 cm.
diagnostic_traits: wiry culms, often branched above base
fertile lemma long, with three very long spreading awns

confusers.separator: Aristida purpurea is perennial and densely tufted, with more basal foliage and a narrower/less airy panicle.
